name: pixii-hand-cranked-dynamo
description: A French instrument maker spun a magnet past wire coils and added a commutator, building the first practical generator.

name: siemens-self-excited-dynamo
description: Werner Siemens showed a generator could feed its own magnets, making powerful electricity affordable at scale.

name: godalming-public-electricity-supply
description: A small English town ran a waterwheel-driven generator to power its street lamps, the first public electricity supply.

name: pearl-street-station-opens
description: Edison's Manhattan power plant began sending electricity through underground wires to paying customers.

name: chicago-worlds-fair-ac-power
friendly_name: AC Lights the Chicago World's Fair
description: Westinghouse lit a vast Chicago exposition with alternating current, winning the argument in the War of the Currents.

name: larderello-geothermal-plant
description: At an Italian volcanic steam field, Prince Ginori Conti ran a small engine on natural steam to light a few bulbs.

name: britain-national-grid-live
description: Pylons carrying high-voltage lines linked power stations into the world's first integrated national electricity network.

name: smith-putnam-wind-turbine
description: A giant two-bladed turbine on a Vermont hilltop became the first megawatt-scale wind machine to supply a power grid.

name: the-geysers-geothermal-plant
description: A Californian plant tapped underground steam to feed a utility's grid, starting large-scale geothermal power in America.

name: northeast-blackout-1965
description: A faulty relay in Ontario cascaded into a failure that plunged millions across the northeastern US and Canada into darkness.

name: rance-tidal-power-station
description: A French estuary barrage began harnessing ocean tides to generate electricity, the first large tidal plant.

name: pacific-dc-intertie-opens
description: A direct-current line carried hydropower from the Pacific Northwest to Los Angeles, a milestone in long-distance transmission.

name: dinorwig-pumped-storage-station
description: A Welsh power station hidden inside a mountain releases stored water in seconds to meet sudden surges in electricity demand.

name: quebec-geomagnetic-blackout
description: A geomagnetic storm collapsed a Canadian provincial grid in seconds, leaving millions without electricity.

name: toyota-prius-launched
description: The first mass-produced hybrid car paired a petrol engine with a battery and electric motor.

name: northeast-blackout-2003
description: A tree-touched power line in Ohio triggered a cascade that darkened cities from New York to Toronto.

name: tesla-roadster-deliveries
description: A sports car powered by thousands of laptop-style cells showed that electric vehicles could be fast and desirable.

name: tesla-powerwall-unveiled
description: A wall-mounted home battery was launched to store rooftop solar power and back up households during outages.

name: hornsdale-power-reserve
description: The world's biggest lithium-ion battery at the time began stabilising South Australia's grid, built in under 100 days.

name: hornsea-offshore-wind-farm
description: More than 170 turbines off the Yorkshire coast began sending power ashore from the then-largest offshore wind farm.

name: iberian-peninsula-blackout
description: A sudden grid collapse left Spain and Portugal without electricity for hours, halting trains and shutting shops.
